name: cryptic_caves_draw_needs_untapped_caves
notes: G3 (drop cost part 2 (CostTap) at 1/1/cost). Printed: '{T}: Add {C}. {1}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card. Activate only if you control five or more lands.' The draw ability costs {T} too. With the Caves and four other lands (five lands) and {W} floating, seat 0 taps the Caves for {C}; the draw ability is then refused (an already-tapped land cannot pay {T}), so the Caves stays on the battlefield, tapped, no card is drawn and the mana stays in the pool.
